r: I was told to see you.

ogam_2.m: Backwards is the burden high and low.
r: Hello? Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild sent me to see you.

ogam_4.m: Two alike in body and mind.
r: Are you going to make any sense?
Hello? Do you know how I can reach Lodar's hideaway?
Are you even listening to what I say?
Hello? Do you know how I can reach Lodar's hideaway?

ogam_lodar_2.m: Lodar, halfway between the Shadow and the light. Rocky formations.
r: OK, halfway between two places. Some rocks?
Glow of the Shadow? Are those the words the guardian needs to hear?
'Glow of the Shadow'? I recognize that from somewhere.

lodar.10: I should find a potion maker called Lodar. Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me that I will need to know the right words to pass a guardian in order to reach Lodar's hideaway.
lodar.15: Umar told me I should go see someone called Ogam in Vilegard. Ogam can supply me with the right words to reach Lodar's hideaway.
lodar.20: I have visited Ogam in southwest Vilegard. He was talking in what seemed like riddles. I could barely make out some details when I asked about Lodar's hideaway. 'Halfway between the Shadow and the light. Rocky formations.' and the words 'Glow of the Shadow.' were among the things he said. I am not sure what they mean.
lodar.30: I have found a formation of rocks on the Duleian Road. It does not look like they were naturally placed, but rather that they are meant to symbolize something.
lodar.31: Could this be the 'rocky formation' that the old man Ogam mentioned? If that is the case, then this might be a clue as to where Andor went.
lodar.40: In the woods close to the rocky formation, I encountered a creature blocking the way into the forest.
lodar.45: By speaking the words that Ogam had mentioned, the creature moved out of the way, and almost seemed to welcome me further into the forest.
lodar.50: I encountered a guard from Feygard in the woods. He told me a tale of a madman that the guards from Feygard are searching for. The madman is wanted for a number of reasons that he would not disclose. He warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them.
lodar.51: Before leaving, the guard warned me both about the twisty mazes ahead, and about the madman. Apparently, several guards have gone missing after venturing forth, either by getting lost in the maze, or by something that the madman has done to them.
lodar.60: I found another rocky formation that looked out of place.
lodar.71: I encountered another guard from Feygard, disoriented and lost. The things he said did not make sense.
lodar.72: I encountered another guard from Feygard, that seemed to be affected by something. He attacked me without provocation.
lodar.73: I encountered another guard from Feygard, that rambled of something that 'lurks underneath'. He attacked me without provocation.
lodar.80: I found yet another rocky formation that looked out of place.
lodar.90: In a well-hidden cave, I encountered yet another rocky formation that looked similar to the other ones that I've already seen. I must be getting close to whatever these formations lead to.
lodar.100: In the cave, I reached what looks like a tomb. I was unable to venture further into the tomb because of something that held me back.
lodar.110: After navigating through the immense twisty green maze and the damp cave, I have reached a cabin in a clearing. The cabin is occupied by the potion-maker called Lodar.

bonemeal.10:
Leonid in Crossglen town hall tells me that there was a disturbance in the village some weeks ago. Apparently, Lord Geomyr has banned all use of bonemeal as a healing substance.

Tharal, the town priest should know more.
bonemeal.20: Tharal does not want to talk about bonemeal. I might be able to persuade him by bringing him 5 insect wings.
bonemeal.30: Tharal tells me that bonemeal is a very potent healing substance, and is quite upset that it is not allowed anymore. I should go see Thoronir in Fallhaven if I want to learn more. I should tell him the password 'Glow of the Shadow'.
bonemeal.40: I have talked to Thoronir in Fallhaven. He might be able to mix me a bonemeal potion if I bring him 5 skeletal bones. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven.
bonemeal.50: Thoronir in Fallhaven explained to me that bonemeal potions are banned by Lord Geomyr, so I have refused his request to provide him with fresh ingredients for new bonemeal potions. I could do him a favour though to bring him 5 skeletal bones for church matters. There should be some skeletons in an abandoned house north of Fallhaven.
bonemeal.100:
I have brought the bones to Thoronir. He is now able to supply me with bonemeal potions.
I should be careful when using them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use.
bonemeal.110: I have brought the bones to Thoronir. Of course he wouldn't produce any bonemeal potion from them though, since Lord Geomyr has banned their use.
